newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's stock exchange expels Csiky brokerage.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's stock exchange expels Csiky brokerage.

text.p: The Council of the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) decided to exclude the brokerage Csiky Partners Ertekpapir Kft from bourse membership, effective on May 6, the BSE said in its official gazette on Wednesday.
Before its exclusion, Csiky's membership had been suspended since November 5 because of deficiencies in its accounting and business registration system, the BSE said.
The BSE decided to exclude Csiky as the brokerage did not upgrade its accounting and registration system and its suspension could not be extended according to the BSE's rules, the bourse said.
